notes: Servings scaler and nutrition facts on the cooking panel. The Ingredients heading now carries x1/2, x1, x2 and x3 chips - tap one and every ingredient quantity rescales, handling fractions (1 1/2 cups -> 3 cups), unicode fractions, decimals and ranges (2-3 lbs -> 4-6 lbs), always shown as cook-friendly fractions; lines without a number (a pinch of nutmeg) are left alone, and anything you have checked off stays checked. Recipes imported from a link now also capture the site's nutrition facts (calories, protein, carbs, fat, fiber, sugar, sodium, servings) - tucked behind a Nutrition button under the recipe title, hidden until tapped. For recipes you already have, open Edit and tap Site photos: it refreshes the nutrition from the source page along with the photo choices, and saving keeps it from then on.
